findings.description: The configuration explicitly annotates this bucket as public and sets no ACL or bucket policy restricting access, so the bucket (and the customer data objects it holds) is exposed to unauthenticated read/write from the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so objects stored in this bucket holding customer data are written to disk unencrypted by default.

The customer-master.xlsx object containing customer data is uploaded without server_side_encryption into a bucket that also lacks default encryption, leaving the sensitive payload stored in cleartext.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so financial data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest by default.
